```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Loads the train and test sets
load("heart_disease_split.RData")
load("heart_disease_cleaned.RData")

# Confirm that we can read them
head(hd_training)
head(hd_testing)
head(heart_disease)

# Copy the data set
heart_diseaseKNN <- heart_disease

heart_diseaseKNN$ca[is.na(heart_diseaseKNN$ca)] <- 0 # Make sure there are no NA values
```

```{r}
ggplot(heart_diseaseKNN, aes(target, after_stat(count))) + geom_bar(aes(fill = ca), position = "dodge")
```


```{r}
# --- KNN Pre processing ---

# All of our numerically categorical values are now factors, so we can make a dummy variable for all of them
dmySex <- dummyVars(" ~ sex", data=heart_diseaseKNN,fullRank=T) 
dummySex <- data.frame(predict(dmySex, newdata= heart_diseaseKNN))

dmyFbs <- dummyVars(" ~ fbs", data=heart_diseaseKNN,fullRank=T) 
dummyFbs <- data.frame(predict(dmyFbs, newdata= heart_diseaseKNN))

dmyRestecg <- dummyVars(" ~ restecg", data=heart_diseaseKNN, fullRank=T)
dummyRestecg <- data.frame(predict(dmyRestecg, newdata=heart_diseaseKNN))

dmyExang <- dummyVars(" ~ exang", data=heart_diseaseKNN, fullRank=T)
dummyExang <- data.frame(predict(dmyExang, newdata=heart_diseaseKNN))

dmySlope <- dummyVars(" ~ slope", data=heart_diseaseKNN, fullRank=T)
dummySlope <- data.frame(predict(dmySlope, newdata=heart_diseaseKNN))

dmyCa <- dummyVars(" ~ ca", data=heart_diseaseKNN, fullRank=T)
dummayCa <- data.frame(predict(dmyCa, newdata=heart_diseaseKNN))

dmythal <- dummyVars(" ~ thal", data=heart_diseaseKNN, fullRank=T)
dummyThal <- data.frame(predict(dmythal, newdata=heart_diseaseKNN))

```

```{r}
# Add the newly created columns to the table
newHD <- cbind(heart_diseaseKNN, dummySex, dummyFbs, dummyRestecg, dummyExang, dummySlope, dummayCa, dummyThal)
newHD
```

```{r}
# Delete the factor columns we no longer need
newHD = subset(newHD, select = -c(2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12))
newHD
```
```{r}
# Regenerate the testing and training sets with the new data frame
set.seed(123)
intrainKNN <- createDataPartition(y = heart_diseaseKNN$target, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

trainingKNN <- newHD[intrainKNN,]
testingKNN <- newHD[-intrainKNN,]
```


```{r}
processminmaxHD <- preProcess(as.data.frame(trainingKNN), method=c("range")) 

trainingKNN <- predict(processminmaxHD,newdata = trainingKNN) 

summary(trainingKNN) # This ensures that everything is in range from 0 - 1
```

```{r}
testingKNN <- predict(processminmaxHD,newdata = testingKNN) 
summary(testingKNN)
```
```{r}
set.seed(123)
trainingKNN$target <- factor(trainingKNN$target) # Treat the target as a factor

trCtrlHD <- trainControl(method="cv") 
knn_fitHD <- train(target ~ ., data=trainingKNN, method = "knn", trControl = trCtrlHD, tuneLength = 20)

knn_fitHD # 9 is the best value here
```

```{r}
# Test the KNN model
set.seed(123)
test_pred_hd <- predict(knn_fitHD, newdata = testingKNN)
test_actual_hd <- as.factor(testingKNN$target)
confusionMatrix(test_actual_hd,test_pred_hd)
```
